title: Validity Check and Its Preliminary Conditions
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $n,s\in\mathbb N$ and $w$ be a finite Boolean word. The validity condition on $w$ is equivalent to the conjunction of the following preliminary conditions and the verifier acceptance test on the prefix of length $W(2s+1)$: $|w|=W(2s+1)+wP(n)+1$, the bit of $w$ at position $W(2s+1)+wP(n)$ is true, and the integer represented by the $wP(n)$ bits immediately after the first $W(2s+1)$ bits, read with the first bit least significant, is at most $n+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
